verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same 320×50 layout and share the same flaws. The headline "Garden-fresh fizz" wraps into two lines that are crammed into the banner height, the can is shrunk to a meaningless sliver under the logo, and the legal text under the CTA is illegible at around 4px while crowding the button. B is slightly better because it keeps the original's light-blue and teal circles, so it still feels like the same brand. A drops them for a flat background, though B's legal text then sits on the teal circle with slightly lower contrast.
